title: The V3 SEO Model: Pick keywords by Value, Verge and Volume for fast organic gains
summary: Cody Schneider describes the V3 SEO Model his agency used on powerful, aged domains to find keywords worth targeting. By combining Value, Verge and Volume, the team built landing pages for search intent and reports a client gaining 51% more organic clicks and 29% more impressions in 30 days.

principles.text: Target keywords that create business value: products, buyer-journey information, and brand identity terms.
principles.quote: Keywords that can create value for the organization. For example, keywords that are related to products, information prospects search for at different stages in the buyer’s journey or keywords important to brand identity.

principles.text: Treat keywords on page two or three as 'verge' keywords: Google signals what you can rank for, and a little work lifts them to page one.
principles.quote: Google signals to us what we can rank for. Keywords on page two and three can often be lifted to page one with just a little work.

principles.text: Only chase keywords with enough search volume for your industry to actually move your analytics.
principles.quote: Our keywords must have the potential energy necessary to create impact to our current search analytics.

principles.text: The sweet spot is the intersection of value, verge and volume (V3 keywords).
principles.quote: When we combine these three ideas, we get The V3 SEO Model.

principles.text: After picking V3 keywords, build landing pages that best answer the search intent of each target keyword.
principles.quote: Once we’ve identified V3 keywords, we then build landing pages that best answer search intent for our new target keywords.
